title: LLCBench: Benchmarking Lossless Compression of Large Language Models
summary: The rapid proliferation of Large Language Models (LLMs) has posed significant challenges to model storage, distribution, and inference. While various reviews and benchmarks for lossy compression like distillation, pruning, and quantization have emerged to address these issues, their inherent lack of data integrity restricts their utility in scenarios requiring high-fidelity persistent backup and the reliable sharing of LLM repositories. To this end, we present the first review and benchmark of lossless compression for LLMs, serving as a further complement to existing lossy work.…
